turns.question: At which hour of the day did the most checkout events happen between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many were there in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hour-level metric: its time grains stop at the day, so it cannot say which hour had the most checkouts or how many there were. The closest metric is Checkout sessions (site sessions with a checkout, on the day of the checkout), which can be read per day for 20 September to 3 October 2026.
